name: Pool with Built-in Spa
headline: A pool and a spa, molded as one shell.
tagline: A rectangular pool with a raised spa and seating section built into one end. One shell, one installation, two ways to use the water.

images.alt: Blue fiberglass pool with a built-in spa section being set into an excavated hillside site at sunset, with palm trees and a mountain behind.
images.caption: Being set into a hillside site

images.alt: Side view of the pool-and-spa shell in the workshop, showing the reinforcing ribs, plumbing stubs and the stepped spa section at one end.
images.caption: In the workshop: ribs and plumbing stubs on the outside

images.alt: Close view of the pool-and-spa shell in its excavation, with a worker connecting plumbing in the trench beside it.
images.caption: Plumbing connected before backfill

priceNote: Shell only. Delivery and installation quoted per site.

features.title: Built-in spa section
features.body: A raised spa area sits at one end of the pool, separated by a molded wall, so it can be heated or jetted on its own.

features.title: Molded seating
features.body: Seats and steps are part of the shell, for sitting in the spa or easing into the main pool.

features.title: Skimmer and light ports
features.body: Openings for the skimmer, lights and return jets are set in the mold before the shell leaves the workshop.

features.title: Coping flange
features.body: The flat lip around the top sits under your deck or tile, hiding the edge of the shell.

features.title: Ribbed exterior
features.body: Reinforcing ribs on the outside stiffen the walls once the shell is backfilled.

specs.label: Top edge
